recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: clear autumn dusk over the bay at sixteen degrees
sunset sliding past seven on equinox week
stamp-sized chips booting linux at the edge
embedded boards closing the gap with raspberry pi
side repos quiet while agents get dreamed up from a phone
surgical edits and sunrise shipping on the mind

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch dissolving fog ribbons drifting down a golden-gate dusk screen before they hit the water; each ribbon you save extends the sunset gradient you're painting.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: drag to position a collector and intercept falling ribbons
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every caught ribbon adds a streak to your personal sunset palette
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: wind gusts widen ribbons, spawn decoy mist, and speed the fall
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor fog, burnt orange autumn palette

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap deploy pulses in rhythm as parallel agents queue GitHub Actions from your phone—miss a beat and the shipping stack backs up.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: rhythm tap on incoming spawn pulses
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: chaining perfect beats launches a rocket labeled shipping by sunrise
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: BPM climbs as more agents join the queue and pulses split into doubles
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon terminal grid on black with shortcut glyphs

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw the shortest surgical path through a cluttered one-screen codebase map—only a precise stroke ships the feature before noise closes in.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to draw, release to commit
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: cleaner paths unlock flow-state visual trails behind your finger
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: noise nodes multiply and the commit window shrinks each round
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout blueprint with red pencil lines

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick tiny ESP32 boards into spinning Linux-shaped socket slots before they overheat—wrong slot sparks and resets your boot chain.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: landing three boards in a row boots a miniature pi desktop on your desk
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: slots rotate faster, boards shrink, and decoy ports appear
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: isometric desk with glowing silicon chips
